id: \bDrayden: I'd like to thank you for your help in developing Iris's abilities. She's become an excellent Trainer.
en: \bDrayden: I'd like to thank you for your help in developing Iris's abilities. She's become an excellent Trainer.
it: \bAristide: Vorrei ringraziarti per aver aiutato Iris a sviluppare le sue capacità. È diventata un'Allenatrice eccellente.

id: \rIris: \PN! It's great to see you again. Can you believe we're both competing in the same competition?
en: \rIris: \PN! It's great to see you again. Can you believe we're both competing in the same competition?
it: \rIris: \PN! Che bello rivederti. Ci credi che partecipiamo tutti e due allo stesso torneo?

id: \rDon't think I'm going to be easy though. Since we last saw each other I've met and battled many Dragon-type Trainers and Pokémon.
en: \rDon't think I'm going to be easy though. Since we last saw each other I've met and battled many Dragon-type Trainers and Pokémon.
it: \rMa non pensare che sarò facile da battere. Dall'ultima volta che ci siamo visti ho incontrato e affrontato tanti Allenatori e Pokémon di tipo Drago.

id: \rPlus, I'm now the Champion of Unova. That's not enough to be a Dragon Master yet. Winning this battle against you will get me one step closer to that.
en: \rPlus, I'm now the Champion of Unova. That's not enough to be a Dragon Master yet. Winning this battle against you will get me one step closer to that.
it: \rInoltre, ora sono il Campione di Unima. Ma non basta ancora per essere un Maestro dei Draghi. Vincere questa lotta contro di te mi porterà un passo più vicino a quel traguardo.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 99. You have entered the Ultra Class.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 99. You have entered the Ultra Class.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai risultati, ora sei al posto 99 della classifica. Sei entrato nella Classe Ultra.

id: \rIris: Ugh, I can't believe I lost. Don't worry, I'll keep getting stronger. Let's battle again once I reach the Ultra Class!
en: \rIris: Ugh, I can't believe I lost. Don't worry, I'll keep getting stronger. Let's battle again once I reach the Ultra Class!
it: \rIris: Uff, non ci credo che ho perso. Non preoccuparti, continuerò a diventare più forte. Rifacciamo una lotta quando avrò raggiunto la Classe Ultra!

id: \rIris: You're so good, but don't be surprised if I win next time.
en: \rIris: You're so good, but don't be surprised if I win next time.
it: \rIris: Sei proprio bravo, ma non stupirti se la prossima volta vinco io.

id: \rIris: Wha! ...Hi \PN! Back to battle a Champion? Good, because I need all the experience I can get if I'm going to become a Dragon Master.
en: \rIris: Wha! ...Hi \PN! Back to battle a Champion? Good, because I need all the experience I can get if I'm going to become a Dragon Master.
it: \rIris: Wah! ...Ciao \PN! Sei tornato a sfidare una Campionessa? Bene, perché mi serve tutta l'esperienza possibile se voglio diventare una Maestra dei Draghi.

id: \rDon't expect an easy victory around here.
en: \rDon't expect an easy victory around here.

id: \rDrayden is far stronger than your average Trainer.
en: \rDrayden is far stronger than your average Trainer.
it: \rAristide è molto più forte dell'Allenatore medio.

id: \bDrayden uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak against the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
en: \bDrayden uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak against the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
it: \bAristide usa Pokémon di tipo Drago. Sono deboli contro i tipi Drago, Ghiaccio e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
en: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
it: \bSono forti contro il tipo Drago e resistono ai tipi Elettro, Fuoco, Erba e Acqua.
